description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `AbstractModifySignalMapper` which extends another class `AbstractCommandSignalMapper`. It is part of a package related to protocol adapter signals in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically handling signal mapping for modify actions such as CREATE, MODIFY, and DELETE.

classes.name: AbstractModifySignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a common implementation for mapping modify signals with supported actions CREATE, MODIFY, and DELETE.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Returns the array of TopicPath actions supported by this mapper, namely CREATE, MODIFY, and DELETE.
